assessments.citation: Wu et al., A New Dataset for Millimeter-Wave Radar Vital Sensing With Reference Signals; DOI 10.34810/data2962 (Catalan Open Research Area / Dataverse; previous IEEE Dataport 10.21227/wq68-sv85)
assessments.hardware: custom non-commercial FMCW radar, 120 GHz ISM band (CommSensLab-UPC)

hr_ecg_ground_truth.signal: Mindray reference: ecg_lead2 (ECG Lead II), ecg_lead3, ecg_leadv1

assessments.time_resolution: Radar 3.0 ms frame interval (333.3 Hz); ECG 2.0 ms (500 Hz), both 120 s

thirty_second_contract.note: 120 s per recording yields 4 x 30 s; using 3 leaves a guard margin. Contract is [t, t+30 s) on the file-relative time origin.

c1_eligibility.reason: C1 targets the spectral-candidate score inside the selection chain over a complex range-domain DataCube (target/bin/channel selection then spectral scoring). This dataset supplies a single already-extracted displacement channel with no range bins and no channels, so C1's mechanism cannot be expressed or tested here.

c2_eligibility.reason: C2 is about spectral-peak selection and anchor persistence on the cardiac waveform. A displacement waveform is sufficient to run that mechanism, although it cannot isolate target-selection interaction.
c2_eligibility.caveat: Cannot test target-selection interaction; result is evidence about the spectral/anchor mechanism only.

development_exposure.what_ran: C1b formal Radar-ECG benchmark, RUN_ID C1B_VS_DATASET_20260825_V1, status BENCHMARK_COMPLETE, 24 subjects / 48 pairs / 384 rows
development_exposure.calibration: single fixed ECG-radar delay (-18.0 ms) estimated from VS01 Resting and held fixed
development_exposure.reported_boundary: benchmark_report.md states the run does NOT validate Radar beat/IBI/HRV; HR/IBI/RMSSD/SDNN rows are diagnostic only
development_exposure.exposed_to: beat-level / timing / HR-magnitude / HRV-metric benchmarking with thin baseline methods
development_exposure.not_exposed_to: the production selection+fusion chain and specifically not the C1 spectral-candidate score or the C2 anchor/SmoothTrack mechanism
development_exposure.tuning_performed: one subject (VS01 Resting) used for a single global delay constant; no per-subject or per-window algorithm tuning

assessments.verdict_reason: Cannot serve C1 at all. For C2 it is usable only as secondary external evidence, because the cohort already produced published benchmark numbers; the C1/C2 mechanisms themselves were never evaluated on it.

assessments.citation: AgeBalanced 60 GHz cohort, 110 participants (Zenodo-distributed), local copy 2026-08-14
assessments.hardware: TI mmWave (60.25 GHz start, B=480 MHz, R_BIN 0.312 m), 2 TX / 4 RX, 64 ADC samples, 32 loops, periodic 10 ms

hr_ecg_ground_truth.ecg_cadence: ~250 Hz (4 ms between samples in the observed file head)

radar_input.note: Range-FFT-domain frames, not raw ADC; target/range selection is still recoverable in principle

assessments.time_resolution: radar frame period 100 ms (10 Hz); ECG ~4 ms

thirty_second_contract.note: 10 Hz frames give 300 frames per 30 s window; ECG at ~250 Hz gives abundant reference.

c1_eligibility.reason: Not eligible for C1 as a validation set, because the cohort has already been used to evaluate and select HR routes (see development_exposure). Eligibility is blocked by exposure, not by format.

development_exposure.what_ran: 2026-08-14 AgeBalanced external ECG reference validation plus multi-bin A/B and HPS / harmonic-notch / VMD comparisons on the historical 220 Resting-session scope
development_exposure.exposed_to: HR accuracy benchmarking and algorithm-route selection (multi-bin, harmonic notch, VMD, HPS, temporal continuity)
development_exposure.not_exposed_to: the production fusion chain and the specific C2 anchor mechanism
development_exposure.tuning_performed: yes at the route level: several candidate processing routes were compared and accepted or reverted on this cohort

assessments.verdict_reason: Route-level exposure means it can no longer serve as an untouched validation set for this programme, even though the exact C2 anchor code was not the object of that tuning.

assessments.citation: TI mmWave raw ADC batch (gby), local copy; 10 files, no documentation packaged
assessments.hardware: TI mmWave raw ADC capture (device/firmware not documented in the local copy)
assessments.subjects: unknown (10 files named gby1..gby10; file-to-subject mapping not documented)

hr_ecg_ground_truth.detail: The directory contains only 10 .bin raw ADC files (13,107,200 bytes each) and no ECG, no respiration reference, no timestamps and no metadata.

radar_input.note: Raw ADC; would require a full range-FFT front end plus a documented capture configuration.

assessments.time_resolution: not determinable from the local copy (no chirp config, no timestamps)

thirty_second_contract.reason: No timestamp vector and no chirp configuration, so neither wall-clock alignment nor a 30 s window can be defined.

c1_eligibility.reason: No HR/ECG ground truth and no time base.

c2_eligibility.reason: No HR/ECG ground truth and no time base.

development_exposure.what_ran: nothing; only referenced once as an inventory line in CHANGELOG.md
development_exposure.not_exposed_to: everything (no analysis ever ran on it)

assessments.verdict_reason: Cannot serve as a validation set: no ECG reference, no timestamps, no acquisition metadata, no documented subject mapping.

routing.primary_reason: No external asset is untouched for this programme: VS_DATASET was used for a completed C1b benchmark (and cannot express C1 anyway), AgeBalanced was used for route-level HR algorithm selection, and the TI gby batch has no reference at all.
routing.secondary_external_evidence: VS_DATASET_healthy_v1 via its C2-applicable displacement waveform, clearly labelled secondary and not a primary untouched validation

next_task: mmwave_hr_untouched_ecg_validation_set_v1 (OPT_A) as primary, with VS_DATASET secondary C2 evidence only
